scope: Qualified ngspice 47 DC resistor/capacitor networks, AC RL/RLC responses with uncoupled ideal inductors, analytic first-order RC transient, independent nodal/raw-data verification, Calc handoff and shared document/console reuse. No DC inductors, mutual coupling, nonlinear devices or general transient support. Named DC/AC/RC finite-sample voltage/magnitude/gain requirements, signed worst-condition margins and explicit component variants; unmet requirements block publication and reuse. No continuous-band/time or all-tolerance guarantee.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_ngspice.py on the target executable with Calc; verify analytic network responses, public/human reuse and all native kit probes.

Run tools/qualify_ngspice_performance.py on the target executable with Calc; verify nominal and component-variant pass/unmet outcomes, finite study failures, forged-summary rejection and downstream/reuse gates.
